regime_context: The Hong Kong detector is in a narrowing rotation (5 of 17 themes eligible, fraction 0.29) led by Banks (H + HK) with Energy (H-shares) as a close challenger. All themes are unscorable (no ETF proxy) except the beaten-down China Tech & Internet and China Platform Megacaps (3033.HK), which sit at the bottom of the ranks and are ineligible. The absolute-trend gate is the one validated risk-control leg, and it is currently helping (gate_helps: true), so trend discipline is worth respecting here.
emerging_watch: Watching Banks (H + HK) leadership: the momentum margin over Energy (0.127) is narrow enough that a CONFIRMED swap (Energy score > Banks score on two consecutive reads) would retire the Banks-as-leader watch and flag a two-leader rotation.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks lead the eligible set with the highest score and a decent durability bar (0.66) paired with non-trivial breadth (0.615), suggesting the leadership is not a one-name spike. The absolute-trend gate (eligible: true) supports staying with the trend while it holds. However, the theme is unscorable, and the challenger Energy is close (margin 0.127), so this is a modest, checkpointed lean rather than a strong call.
evidence: gate_helps true (trend discipline validated as risk control)
theses.dissent: This is a mean-reverting leg historically (hurst_tag mixed) with r10 of -0.016, and the cross-sectional momentum rank has rank-IC ~0 — the leadership itself carries no forward return signal.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) scores fall below 1.0 and lose eligible status before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is eligible, trend-tagged, and has the highest durability bar in the eligible set (0.81) with strong breadth (0.8), making it the most cohesive trend among eligible themes. It is the confirmed challenger to Banks, not a speculative next narrative. The market is not one-narrative dominant (one_narrative: false), so a two-theme leadership structure (Banks + Energy) is consistent with the detector state.
theses.dissent: The momentum rank itself is not a return forecast (rank-IC ~0), and the narrow margin to Banks means any leadership handoff is unconfirmed; Energy could revert without any fundamental trigger.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) drops below the absolute-trend gate (eligible flips false) within 20 trading days

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: High-Dividend Blue Chips sits within the eligible set (rank 4) with trend-tagged hurst and mid-level durability (0.62) and breadth (0.5). In a narrowing rotation with only five eligible themes, the eligible group itself is the de-risked universe, and this theme's presence inside the gate is the basis for a modest stay-with-trend lean rather than a chase of the top ranks.
theses.dissent: Its score is barely half of the leader Banks, and ineligible themes further down (e.g. Conglomerates at 0.603) are not far behind — the eligible/ineligible boundary could shift quickly and this lean relies on a weak durability signal.
